name: futures_weekend_gap_is_market_closure
why: The platform's freshness monitor allows 26 hours, and futures_prices is keyed on the trading day, not the load time. Every Monday morning the newest trade_date is Friday's, some 60 hours old, while the pipeline loaded on schedule. Escalating that trains the team to ignore the one monitor that catches a dead Yahoo feed.

monitor_rows.message: Hours since max(trade_date) is 60.0 at Monday 12:00 UTC; max(trade_date) is Friday. The pipeline's last load finished Monday 06:05 UTC with status ok and merged 240 rows. CME, CBOT, NYMEX, COMEX and ICE US do not settle on Saturday or Sunday.
